map.生成条数钳制在 1–50（缺省 5）；第 i 条默认按 i 对 8 取模循环选取: The count is clamped to 1-50 (default 5). By default the i-th entry cycles through eight keyframe templates — fadeIn, slideUp, bounce, pulse, rotate, shake, zoomIn, flip — by i mod 8; picking an animation type applies it to the whole batch. The name is the template name plus a random 1-999 integer. Duration (0.5-3.0 s), delay (0-2.0 s), easing, iteration count (1/2/3/infinite), direction and fill mode stay random when left blank and are fixed to your choice otherwise, then everything is assembled into an animation declaration plus a @keyframes block. The preview area at the top actually applies the first animation to a swatch on a loop (the @keyframes are injected into a real style element, not merely displayed as text), so you can judge the motion before copying the code.
